text:
maya (People Ops): Short open-mic after today's all-hands for hybrid/remote + offsite clarifications. Ask quick Qs and we'll answer inline.

tom (Eng): If I book a 5-day satellite week, do I need manager approval for travel?

maya (People Ops): Manager approval required for travel >3 days. For single-day visits just book via the hot-desk flow.

emma (HR): Also confirm if you're incurring hotel costs so we can suggest per-diem vs. corporate booking.

tom (Eng): Are partners/family covered for company offsites?

carlos (People Ops): Not covered by default. We may approve caregiver or accommodation exceptions—submit the travel-exception form and tag @carlos.

rebecca (People Ops): Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day available for overnight company offsites with manager sign-off. Receipts needed.

tom (Eng): How about equipment movement between sites? Need to bring a small demo rack.

maya (People Ops): Anything valued over $2k needs IT + legal sign-off and the hardware-transfer form. Small peripherals OK.

offsite-bot: Poll: "Best offsite month" Apr / May / Sep. Voting open 24h.

emma (HR): We'll package these notes into a 1-pager and pin it in #people-ops. DM us for urgent exceptions.
